title: Choose a Rite
description: Eidolon's native progression divides into sacred and wicked ritual paths. REIGN does not turn that upstream language into a universal moral law: demonstrate command of either path. Holy or dark expression does not by itself decide whether the Overlord may master the discipline.
description_completed: The Overlord has committed to a mature Eidolon ritual path. The wider rites remain open without forcing both branches into one checklist.

objectives.name: Commit to either Eidolon ritual path
